source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
Friendly units gain these abilities:

- **Harnessed Alien Instincts**, for **KROOT** and **VESPID STINGWINGS** units: in your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), the unit may make a **visible** enemy unit up to 12" away **prey-marked**; a **prey-marked** unit gets +3" to its **detection range**.
- **Localised Stealth Projectors (Aura)**, for **GHOSTKEEL BATTLESUIT** and **STEALTH BATTLESUITS** units: when a friendly **KROOT** or **VESPID STINGWINGS** unit up to 6" from this unit has shot, its attacks do not stop it from being **[hidden](vsdata:core-rule/hidden)**.

Tagged **AUXILIARIES**: this **detachment** cannot be taken alongside another **AUXILIARIES** **detachment**.
